patch_list: Opening the daily wheel with a free spin spins it, collects the chips and closes it.
Opening "My packs" opens every unopened collection pack one after another.
Claims the free daily wheel spin in the background when it is ready; the chip counter counts up.
Shows all cards of a pack at once and skips the pauses between packs, star packs included.
Stops the loading screen from hanging when a download stalls, e.g. behind a VPN.
Allows Google sign-in through MicroG-RE (needed after patching).
Removes the full-screen ads before Solo games. Optional reward videos stay.
The game turns with the phone when it is held upside down in landscape.
